De Haan shared that as of Sept. 21, the average price for regular gas was $4.44 per gallon nationwide. This is an increase of 18.5 cents from the prior week and an increase of $1.28 from the prior year.
For diesel, the average price nationwide is $6.49 per gallon, up 30.7 cents per gallon from last week and up $2.83 per gallon from the same time last year.
Prices rose in nearly every state, with the Great Lakes region hit particularly hard, with costs rising over the weekend due to refinery issues.
